description: Utility functions for handling channel icons, permissions, navigation, and modal prompts in Mattermost's web application.

methods.name: canManageMembers
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to manage members of a given channel based on channel type.

methods.name: findNextUnreadChannelId
methods.description: Finds the index of the next unread channel in a list, given current channel and direction.

methods.name: isArchivedChannel
methods.description: Determines if a channel is archived based on its delete_at property.

methods.name: getArchiveIconComponent
methods.description: Returns the icon component for archived channels, differing for private and public.

methods.name: getArchiveIconClassName
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name for archive icons, differing for private and public.

methods.name: getChannelIconComponent
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon component for a channel based on its archived status and type.

methods.name: joinPrivateChannelPrompt
methods.description: Opens a modal prompt to join a private channel, handling user actions and navigation.

methods.name: makeNewEmptyChannel
methods.description: Creates a new empty channel object with specified display name and team ID.
